title: API schema change: response field removed from a public endpoint
context: A field is removed from a documented REST response consumed by other teams.

business_criticality.basis: three internal services consume this endpoint

change_magnitude.basis: one field removed from one response

coverage_deficit.basis: contract tests exist but do not assert this field

irreversibility.basis: consumers may already have broken by the time it is noticed

reasoning_notes: Removing a response field is a breaking change regardless of diff size. Contract testing must be applicable.
No UI signal, so every browser-oriented category must be excluded -- this is the main thing this case checks.
